chains.title: No TF-mediated effect of rs7001688
predictions: The ref and alt alleles show no reproducible difference in TF binding or in CYP7A1 expression attributable to this variant.
The LDL association, if real, could reflect linkage to another causal variant or another non-TF mechanism.
falsified_if: A reproducible allele-dependent TF-binding effect is shown at this site and linked to a corresponding change in target-gene expression and LDL-related function.

chains.title: Alt allele strengthens HNF4A binding and increases CYP7A1 expression
chains.element: A hypothetical cis-regulatory element containing rs7001688

links.claim: Hypothesis: the alt T allele binds HNF4A more strongly than ref G; no occupancy or QBiC-SELEX result was supplied, so this direction is an unverified prediction. HNF4A is proposed because it is a liver-enriched regulator, not because variant-specific evidence identifies it over related factors.
The variant lies in a cis-regulatory element active in Hep3B2.1-7 cells; this element assignment is unverified.
The element increases CYP7A1 expression when HNF4A binds more strongly; the variant-to-gene link is unverified.
The proposed effect occurs in the Hep3B2.1-7 liver-derived cell context.
If increased CYP7A1 activity increases hepatic conversion of cholesterol to bile acids, this chain predicts lower LDL cholesterol; the net effect on LDL is uncertain.

predictions: An allele-specific HNF4A binding assay will show greater binding to alt than ref.
If the chain is correct, an isogenic alt allele will increase CYP7A1 expression relative to ref.
falsified_if: HNF4A shows no reproducible allele-specific binding difference under relevant conditions, or the alt allele does not increase CYP7A1 expression when tested in an appropriate cell context.

chains.title: Ref allele strengthens FOXA2 binding and increases CYP7A1 expression
chains.element: A hypothetical cis-regulatory element containing rs7001688

links.claim: Hypothesis: the ref G allele binds FOXA2 more strongly than alt T; no occupancy or QBiC-SELEX result was supplied, so this direction is an unverified prediction. FOXA2 is considered as a liver-associated DNA-binding factor, but the supplied information does not distinguish it from related factors.
The variant lies in a cis-regulatory element active in Hep3B2.1-7 cells; this element assignment is unverified.
The element increases CYP7A1 expression when FOXA2 binds more strongly; the variant-to-gene link is unverified.
The proposed effect occurs in the Hep3B2.1-7 liver-derived cell context.
If increased CYP7A1 activity increases hepatic conversion of cholesterol to bile acids, this chain predicts lower LDL cholesterol; the net effect on LDL is uncertain.

predictions: An allele-specific FOXA2 binding assay will show greater binding to ref than alt.
An isogenic ref allele will increase CYP7A1 expression relative to alt if this chain is correct.
falsified_if: FOXA2 shows no reproducible allele-specific binding difference under relevant conditions, or the ref allele does not increase CYP7A1 expression when tested in an appropriate cell context.

chains.title: Alt allele strengthens CEBPA binding and represses CYP7A1
chains.element: A hypothetical cis-regulatory element containing rs7001688

links.claim: Hypothesis: the alt T allele binds CEBPA more strongly than ref G; no occupancy or QBiC-SELEX result was supplied, so this direction is an unverified prediction. CEBPA is considered as a liver-associated factor, but there is no variant-specific evidence selecting it over related factors.
The variant lies in a cis-regulatory element active in Hep3B2.1-7 cells; this element assignment is unverified.
The element represses CYP7A1 expression when CEBPA binds more strongly; this regulatory direction and the variant-to-gene link are unverified.
The proposed effect occurs in the Hep3B2.1-7 liver-derived cell context.
If reduced CYP7A1 activity reduces hepatic conversion of cholesterol to bile acids, this chain predicts higher LDL cholesterol; the net effect on LDL is uncertain.

predictions: An allele-specific CEBPA binding assay will show greater binding to alt than ref.
An isogenic alt allele will reduce CYP7A1 expression relative to ref if this chain is correct.
falsified_if: CEBPA shows no reproducible allele-specific binding difference under relevant conditions, or the alt allele does not reduce CYP7A1 expression when tested in an appropriate cell context.

matrix.test: Allele-specific EMSA using ref and alt probes with HNF4A, FOXA2, and CEBPA individually, with a factor-specific supershift or equivalent specificity control

outcomes.outcome: No reproducible allele-specific shift for the candidate factors.
HNF4A-specific shift is stronger with the alt probe.
FOXA2-specific shift is stronger with the ref probe.
CEBPA-specific shift is stronger with the alt probe.

next_experiment: Run the allele-specific EMSA with HNF4A, FOXA2, and CEBPA separately and factor-specific controls. It is the lowest-cost direct test of the leading HNF4A binding hypothesis against the null; a positive result would still require follow-up to establish occupancy, target-gene regulation, and relevance to LDL.
